Name: PFM - Industrialization and Industrialization Plus Golden Crops Addon - English and Simplified Chinese
Author: Uberwind
Description:
Fix [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5102]Industrialization[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9777]Industrialization Plus[/url]﻿ producing rules for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11503]Golden Crops[/url]. Apply for ALL price versions. 

For example,  Golden Hops are able to turn into Golden Pale ales instead of juice category products now.

Optional file is specific for Simplified Chinese version.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12094][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12094][/url][color=#f6b26b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12094]Golden Crops -Chinese[/url]﻿﻿[/color] or[color=#e69138] [/color][color=#e69138][url=http://][/url][/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13667][color=#e69138]Golden Crops Chinese20x version[/color][/url][color=#f6b26b] [/color][color=#f4f4f4]MUST required.[/color]﻿﻿[color=#f6b26b]﻿
